conventions.C1: (2/pi) int dk k^2 W_1(k)^2, fractional count contrast; per-component dipole RMS sqrt(3 C1/4pi); TN16 Eq. (3.9) C1=(4pi/9) D^2

V1_powerlaw_identity.description: P = k^-2: k-space integrator vs exact real-space double integral

V3_camb_number_counts.description: CAMB 2.0.5 SplinedSourceWindow non-Limber C_l (raw), massless neutrinos, b=2, smooth Gaussian test windows in z (z0, sigma) = (0.5, 0.15), (1.0, 0.30); magnification test with x=0.5 (dlog10Ndm=0.2, coefficient 5s-2=-1); last column: CAMB all GR source terms vs density+RSD+lensing at x=1 (size of omitted velocity/potential terms)

V3_low_l_systematic.method: power-law fit of |C_l^integrator/C_l^CAMB - 1| over the tested l per V3 window, extrapolated to l = 1; s = max over windows; integrator below CAMB at all tested l => one-sided upward factor 1/(1 - s) (the CAMB-like value if the deficit is a fractional deficit of the integrator)
V3_low_l_systematic.transfer_caveat: taken from the worst smooth Gaussian test window (b = 2); the radio n(z) brackets were not run through CAMB (runtime), so the factor is transferred, not measured, for them
V3_low_l_systematic.status: unexplained low-l offset to CAMB counts_density: not the integrator P(k) sampling or matter variable, CAMB accuracy variation recorded (V3_DIAGNOSTIC.json); carried as a systematic, not a correction

linear.note: differential = C1 of [W_i - W_j] for two bracket members, i.e. the l=1 power of delta_resolved - delta_compact if each class follows one bracket member; 4 max C1 is the Minkowski bound (sqrt(C_i)+sqrt(C_j))^2 over the extended set; V4 is the numerical convergence of the integrator only; the unexplained V3 low-l offset to CAMB is carried separately in with_V3_low_l_systematic

with_V3_low_l_systematic.note: upper envelope values x factor_up, lower x factor_down; see V3_low_l_systematic for the method

shot_noise_R65_NVSS.note: R106's closed form Cov = Cov_{C1=0} + df^2 (3 C1/4pi) I_2 uses the clustering-only C1 of g_diff; Poisson noise is generated by the multinomial placement inside Cov_{C1=0}. The with-shot-noise numbers are C1 + 1/Nbar for the count fields (TN16 Eq. 3.4) and C1_diff + 1/Nbar_off + 1/Nbar_diag for g_diff; feeding them into p(C1) double counts Poisson noise.
